standard: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 (contrast minimum) and SC 1.4.11 (non-text contrast)
disabledTextNote: text-disabled is exempt under WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 and is measured here anyway at the 3:1 non-text threshold. Stricter than the standard, never looser.
focusIndicatorNote: Focus is two concentric bands: focus-ring clears 3:1 against every surface, focus-ring-contrast clears 3:1 against every fill and against focus-ring. One colour provably cannot do both.

palettes.name: Sepia and pure black
palettes.summary: A warm paper light theme and a pure-black dark theme. Low glare, warm rather than clinical, and the least tiring of the three over a long continuous session.

palettes.name: Cool slate and deep navy
palettes.summary: A cool, crisp light theme and a deep blue-charcoal dark theme. Reads as an instrument rather than as paper, and holds structure better when a screen is genuinely dense.

palettes.name: Neutral ink with one accent
palettes.summary: Near-achromatic surfaces carrying a single strong accent. The highest tonal contrast of the three, so structure is read from edges and weight rather than from colour.

generatedStylesheet.detail: tokens/palettes.css matches tokens/palettes.mjs byte for byte.
